title: What happens to trash at a waste-to-energy plant?

beats.throw: the guy tosses the trash bag (it has a face) in an arc
beats.vanish: the bag lands, blinks, still there - smug
beats.piles: bags rain down and stack into a mountain, camera pulls back
beats.stinking: green stink lines, flies, guy pinches nose
beats.black: black smoke puffs fill the sky, sky darkens, guy coughs
beats.crane: CUT inside the plant: crane claw grabs trash from the pit (the bag gasps)
beats.furnace: claw drops it into the closed furnace
beats.tumbles: trash tumbles down the stepped moving grate
beats.air: blue air arrows push up from under the grate, flames roar
beats.boils: pipes in the furnace walls fill with bubbles
beats.steam: steam puffs race along the pipe
beats.turbine: the turbine spins up (with a face)
beats.power: lightning down the power line, house windows light up
beats.homes: orange heat pipe, houses smile warmly
beats.lime: white lime powder sprays into the smoke duct, acid bubbles fizz away
beats.carbon: black carbon powder grabs mercury and dioxin specks
beats.bags: rows of fabric bags puff up and catch the dust
beats.plume: the chimney (with a face) breathes out a white puffy plume
beats.magnets: a magnet with a face pulls cans and nails out of the ash
beats.gravel: the rest pours into a gravel pile, road
beats.subscribe: CUT back to the town: guy on the new road, SUBSCRIBE button + cursor
beats.work: click, bell rings; loop to frame 0
